verdict.rationale: Reusable components with variants and per-instance overrides are a fair question for a design tool like Canva, so the axis applies. The evidence only covers Brand Templates, bulk create and autofill. Templates are a different feature from linked component instances, and nothing documents variants, per-instance overrides or instances that stay linked to their source.

support.subject: As a designer, I can build reusable components with variants and per-instance overrides that stay linked to their source
